::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** July 28 1857  
**From:** Otterbourne Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Westcountry Studies Library, Exeter/ Yonge 1857/2[^1]
:::

My dear [Miss Smith](people/person_263.qmd)
I should have been glad to accept your ‘Manchester Visit’, but it has been forestalled as you will [see](organizations/other_52.qmd) on the first of August.

I have put out [your princesses](other_books/otherbook_262.qmd) for October but I do not feel sure how the space will be[^2]

yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: With envelope addressed to Miss Anne Smith/ Stepney Rectory/ London and postmarked Winchester 29 July and on reverse 30 July 1857.
[^2]: ‘A Glimpse into a Royal Home Seventy Years Ago’ *MP* 14 (November 1857) 470-96.
